rules.title: NW.js games (Game.exe), personal
config: # Personal recommended settings for NW.js games (Game.exe): RPG Maker MV/MZ and the like.
# Reset to Recommended, at the bottom of the game's settings, brings them back.
notes: Internship[demo] (RPG Maker MZ on NW.js 0.48), build 627, iPhone16,1, iOS 27.0.1, 2026-11-02: about 6 minutes at 57-60 fps with these lines. Each one answers a cause seen in the device logs of runs 3-17: TLS_CLEAR_OWN_PROCESS the Chromium 'Check failed: current' fatals from cross-process TlsFree, X64_IMAGE_NOCOPY the pool EXHAUSTED on per-child copies of nw.dll, ANON_LDADDAL64 the 64-bit LDADDAL on an anonymous alias, WASM_GUARD_TRIM V8's 10 GB WebAssembly reservations, pool-split and pool-low the anonymous RWX pool exhaustion (wasm code commit). THREAD_STACK_SPILL and DATAIMP were in the working config; that each is needed is not shown.
Upstream's nwjs-game-exe sets MADEIRA_CHILD_ARGS, which reaches --type=crashpad-handler children and stops the game at start (runs 1-2); this rule leaves it out.

rules.title: CEF games (any program beside libcef.dll), personal
config: # Personal recommended settings for games built on the Chromium Embedded Framework.
# Reset to Recommended, at the bottom of the game's settings, brings them back.
notes: Hypothesis from Internship [demo] (NW.js), not tried on a device: CEF starts the same Chromium child processes (gpu, renderer, utilities), each mapping libcef.dll (100 MB and more), which ran the JIT pool out for nw.dll; X64_IMAGE_NOCOPY and DATAIMP answered that, pool-split and pool-low the anonymous RWX exhaustion of V8's code. The three switches every game gets (TLS_CLEAR_OWN_PROCESS, ANON_LDADDAL64, WASM_GUARD_TRIM) need no line.
